orchestration_components_to_implement.primary_method: run(repo_path, output_format, env, nvd_cache, raw_tool_output, vex_statements, last_synced_at) -> ScanResult
key_behaviors: Validate job before any scanning (reject multi-repo, unknown env)
Check cache staleness before scanning; add warning to ScanResult if stale
Normalise + deduplicate raw tool output via OSSToolAdapter
Map vulnerabilities from deduped deps via VulnerabilityMapper
Apply VEX filter BEFORE enrichment (not after)
Serialise to CycloneDX or SPDX based on output_format parameter
Make zero network calls (all data from supplied nvd_cache)
Wrap result in SyncResult dataclass with records_added, records_updated, synced_at, source_path, sync_log
Allow NVDSyncError to propagate — do not catch and swallow
Record workflow_states_visited if state machine is tracked

methods: invoke_scan(repo, fmt, env, output_path=None) -> {exit_code, stdout, stderr}
key_behaviors: invoke_scan: validate then call ScanOrchestrator.run; exit 0 on success
invoke_scan: on validation failure, exit non-zero with error to stderr
invoke_scan: on stale cache warning, write warning to stderr but exit 0
invoke_scan: write SBOM JSON to stdout or output_path file
invoke_sync: call NVDSyncOrchestrator.run; exit 0 on success; print counts to stdout
invoke_sync: on NVDSyncError, exit non-zero with error to stderr

transitions.guard: Local cache used — no live API call

state_requirements.persistence: in-memory (no external DB for orchestration state)

ScanResult.dependencies: List[Dict] — all deps from OSSToolAdapter after dedup
ScanResult.warnings: List[str] — stale cache warnings and other non-fatal messages
ScanResult.sbom_document: Dict — serialized CycloneDX or SPDX document
ScanResult.workflow_states_visited: List[str] — ordered list of state values visited

SyncResult.sync_log: Dict with synced_at, source_path, records_added, records_updated

critical_ordering_constraints: VEXFilter.apply() MUST run before RemediationEnricher.enrich() on each vuln
ScanJobValidator.validate() MUST run before OSSToolAdapter is invoked
NVDCacheManager.is_stale() MUST be checked before VulnerabilityMapper runs

rules_enforced_at_orchestration_boundary.rule: No Live NVD API Call at Scan Time
rules_enforced_at_orchestration_boundary.enforcement: All vuln data served from supplied nvd_cache dict only
Add warning to ScanResult.warnings if last_synced_at >= 7 days ago; do NOT abort

gap_exclusions: License detection (Out of Scope per spec)
Real-time NVD API calls (Out of Scope Phase 2)
AI BOM scanning (Out of Scope Phase 1B)
